anomalies.observed: The CAN0 low-side net /CAN0_N also contains the HDMI0 I2C clock: J1.15 (HDMI SCL) and Module1.200 (HDMI0_SCL, open-collector). The net therefore joins the isolated CAN0 bus (U11 CANL, J2.8, J13.8, R34, D10) with the CM4 HDMI0 SCL line. No separate /HDMI0_SCL net exists, while the other HDMI signals (e.g. /HDMI0_SDA on J1.16 and Module1.199) remain separate.
anomalies.expected: The CM4 HDMI0_SCL line (Module1.200 to J1.15) should be its own net, isolated from the CAN0_N differential-bus wire. CAN0_N should connect only to the CAN transceiver, the M12 pin 8 connectors, the TVS diode, and the termination network.

evidence.quote: /CAN0_N : D10.1(Input,input) J1.15(SCL,passive) J13.8(Pin_8,passive) J2.8(Pin_8,passive) Module1.200(HDMI0_SCL,open_collector) R34.1(1,passive) U11.6(CANL,bidirectional)

anomalies.impact: The CM4 HDMI0 I2C/SCL pin is tied to the CAN0 bus low line. This would corrupt CAN0 communication with the Odrive motor controllers and could load or drive the CAN bus from the CM4 pin. Electrically it can also short the CAN transceiver's CANL to the CM4 open-drain I2C pin, possibly damaging the transceiver or the CM4 GPIO.

anomalies.observed: The LSM6DS3 auxiliary I2C master pins SDX (U31.2) and SCX (U31.3) are tied to the GND net, while the other IMU control pins (CS on +3V3, SDO/SA0 via a jumper) are configured explicitly.
anomalies.expected: Per typical LSM6DS3 usage, SDX/SCX are left unconnected or pulled to VDDIO when the auxiliary interface is unused. Tying the SCX clock input to ground is not a standard configuration.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U31.2(SDX,bidirectional) U31.3(SCX,input) U31.6(GND,power_in) U31.7(GND,power_in)

anomalies.impact: With the aux interface unused this is probably harmless, but it is an unusual configuration that could cause unwanted behaviour if the aux I2C mode is enabled, and may indicate an unintended connection.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows the CM4 HDMI0_SCL line (Module1.200 and J1.15) merged into the isolated CAN0_N bus net, which corrupts the CAN0 bus and risks damaging the transceiver. This is a clear bridged-net deviation from the intended design. A lower-confidence note is that the LSM6DS3 SDX/SCX pins sit on GND.
